verdict.rationale: DeepSeek offers a well-documented public API (api-docs.deepseek.com) compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, with detailed guides on JSON mode, function calling, streaming, rate limits, context caching, and model lifecycle changes — clearly enabling AI-native users to drive the product programmatically. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage via tools like Cline/OpenRouter, confirming the API is actively used, though some report reliability/function-calling issues in practice. Missing for 10: deeper independent verification of full API robustness beyond anecdotal community reports.
